names: Province of British Columbia — Water Management Branch (water rentals)
period: a yearly statement (twice a year above $100,000): “Once a year for all other annual rentals less than $100,000.00.” “Twice a year if the annual rental is over $100,000.00”
delivery: a statement to the licence holder on record: “Your statement reflects your annual rental charge for the right to use the water allocated to you under your water licence.” … “Our statements are sent to the client(s) we currently have registered on record as the water licence holder.”
payment: by online banking or by cheque to the Minister of Finance (no e-transfer, no wire): “Online banking for water rental fees” … “Must be made out to "Minister of Finance"”
unpaid: “If an overdue account is not settled within a reasonable amount of time, it runs the risk of being forwarded to a collection agency.”
